docs.text: 4.2 API message specification The API messages supported by HBee24 are described in this section. API type ID 0x01 : Set Coordinator (command) Direction: Host → HBee24 (Coordinator) This API message determines the operation mode of the network coordinator. HBee24 operates in two modes: Install mode and Operation mode . New devices can join the network in Install mode , but not in Operation mode . The host may allow new devices to join the network during operation by changing the mode from Operation mode to Install mode . Field Description API Type ID 0x01 Message Name Set Coordinator Message Type Command Direction Host → HBee24 (Coordinator) Mode 1 Install mode Mode 2 Operation mode Join Permission Allowed only in Install mode Note To allow a new device to join during operation, the host must switch the coordinator to Install mode. Payload Byte Field Size Description 0 API Type ID 1 byte 0x01 1 Mode 1 byte 0x00 : Operation mode, 0x01 : Install mode Frame Fields Offset Example Description Start Delimiter 0 0x7E Length MSB 1 0x00 Data length in bytes. The example indicates 3-byte data. LSB 2 0x03 Data API Type ID 3 0x02 Result 4 0xA5 Response to Set Coordinator Command: ACK/NACK * 0xA5 - ACK * 0x5A - NACK Code 5 0x00 Status code for the response. In case of ACK, the code is 0x00. Supported values include the following: * 0x00 - Success * 0xF1 - Wrong parameters (e.g., Network mode 0xFF) Checksum 6 0x58
